findings.title: PDA derived with create_program_address and a non-canonical bump
findings.fix: Use `find_program_address`, which returns the canonical bump, or Anchor's `#[account(seeds = [..], bump)]`.

findings.title: Unchecked compound arithmetic - overflow panic (DoS) / wraparound
findings.fix: Use checked_add/checked_sub/checked_mul or the `checked` math pattern; anchor 0.29+ `#[access_control]` won't save you here.
